entities.name: LADN information
entities.description: Information element used to assign new LADN information to the UE or delete existing LADN information at the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives and processes LADN information.

entities.name: Assign new LADN information
entities.description: Condition where the network assigns new LADN information to the UE.

entities.name: Delete LADN information
entities.description: Condition where the network deletes existing LADN information at the UE.

relations.description: The LADN information IE is used when assigning new LADN information to the UE.
The LADN information IE is used when deleting LADN information at the UE.
Assigning new LADN information establishes updated LADN configuration at the UE.
Deleting LADN information establishes removal of LADN configuration at the UE.
